title: Authentication and authorisation: privilege escalation and sessions

videos.script: Lesson one wrote down a promise. One customer's token cannot read another customer's booking. {{promise}} Today you check it. Two customers sign in. The second one asks for the first one's booking, and the service has to say no. {{two}} That is horizontal escalation: the same role, somebody else's data. {{sideways}} Then a customer asks for the list only staff may read. That is vertical escalation, reaching for a role you were never given. {{upwards}} A token is a password with an end. You log out and the token stops working. You shorten the clock to two seconds and watch a session expire. {{clock}} You look inside the database. No password in it, and no live token either. {{table}} You guess a password five times, and the sixth try is refused, even when it is right. {{limit}} And every one of those probes becomes a test. Then you remove the role check, and exactly one test turns red. {{red}}
